headline: From crossing by boat to having road access: the impact of the Rizo de Oro bridge in Chiapas
summary: The Rizo de Oro bridge in Chiapas, Mexico, required an investment of 2,308 million pesos. It is expected to cut travel times by up to two and a half hours and benefit over 300,000 residents.
why: Road infrastructure projects funded by the Mexican government shape regional logistics, access to markets and local economic activity.
original_headline: De cruzar en lancha a tener conexión carretera: el impacto del puente Rizo de Oro en Chiapas
